text:
nina: heads up, ap-south firewall microtiers just rolled. seeing GPU warm-pool nodes fail to finish bootstrap.
alex: oh no. error samples?
nina: paste from gpu-ap-012:
```
keystore-client: POST https://priv-keystore.ap-south.internal/decrypt -> 403 Forbidden {"error":"principal not in firewall-allowlist"}
node: gpu-ap-012
stack: node-init -> keystore-decrypt -> bootstrap-failure
```
priya: that looks like the keystore proxy principal was never added to the new tier's allowlist.
kevin: confirm: the microtier denies privatelink traffic from worker-subnets by default unless principal/sg is allowlisted. controlplane canary passed because it uses controlplane SG.
alex: mitigation options: add principal allowlist, rollback tiering, or open a short-lived rule to allow priv-link for worker subnets. which low-risk?
kevin: add the allowlist entry for role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/keystore-proxy in the ap-south tier. no deploys.
priya: i'll make the change in IDP and flag ops to watch.
infrastructure-bot: runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/privatelink-keystore-authz - step 3 covers allowlist apply.
priya: applied. propagation expected ~40s. monitoring warm-pool joins.
nina: seeing gpu-ap-012 and gpu-ap-013 join. warm-pool recovering. thanks.
alex: follow-ups: 1) expand canary to cover worker subnets, 2) add smoke test that attempts keystore decrypt during node-join, 3) add an audit event whenever firewall allowlist entries are modified for privatelink principals.
kevin: filed SEC-4599 to track audit + postmortem. tagging eng-security.
ina: leaving rollout paused in ap-south until smoke checks pass in staging.
infra-bot: alert: keystore-authz-failures resolved for ap-south; rollout paused by nina at 2024-07-04T09:14:35Z
